newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Defence Minister Victor Babiuc released General Dumitru Cioflina from his position as secretary of state and chief of staff and appointed General Constantin Degeratu in his place.
General Dan Zaharia was appointed secretary of state and head of the army's procurement department, replacing General Florentin Popa.

* Experts in the Romanian and Hungarian foreign ministries continued talks to set up a bilateral commission to implement the treaty signed last year and to prepare opening of consular offices in Romania and Hungary. An end to the talks is expected on Friday.
* Greece will support Romania in its bid to join the NATO and the EU, said Greek oficialls during a visit to Greece by Romania's Foreign Minister Adrian Severin.
* Germany will back Romania's bid for early NATO admission, German MP Klaus Franke said during his visit to Romania.
* Labour Minister Alexandru Athanasiu presented on Thursday the main social protection steps to be taken in the first half of February.

The measures, outlined at a news conference of the Democratic Party, include higher child benefits and increased pensions for disavantaged pensioners to cushion the effects of recent and expected price rises.
* The National Liberal Party (PNL) will not form any alliance outside the Democratic Convention, PNL chairman Mircea Ionescu Quintus said at a news confference.
PNL criticised the central bank (BNR) for the recent steep depreciation of the leu currency asking it detail methods of computing its reference rate for the leu.
* Parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies ended debates on a draft law on teaching staff. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
